10k.note: Medical device company. CytoSorb hemoperfusion adsorber CE-marked in EU and distributed in 70+ countries. Lead U.S./Canada development asset is DrugSorb-ATR (antithrombotic removal system). STAR-T pivotal IDE completed enrollment in 2023 (140 patients); De Novo submission filed Sept 2024, denied April 2025, appeal upheld denial Aug 2025 with no safety issues; new De Novo submission being prepared in 2026. STAR-D IDE study on hold. PROCYSS (Germany, refractory septic shock) paused pending protocol amendment.

ctgov.note: All three returned trials are non-active: NCT04643639 (sepsis hemoperfusion, COMPLETED, sponsor Radboud UMC), NCT01879176 (cardiopulmonary bypass cytokine removal, COMPLETED, sponsor Med Univ Vienna), NCT02111018 (rhabdomyolysis, WITHDRAWN, sponsor CytoSorbents). No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 trials currently enrolling per ctgov.

commercial_product.category: Extracorporeal blood purification medical device (hemoperfusion adsorber)
commercial_product.approval_status: CE Mark in EU (since 2011) for cytokine removal in critical care; CE Mark label expansions in 2020 for ticagrelor and rivaroxaban removal during cardiopulmonary bypass. Distributed in 70+ countries with >300,000 devices used cumulatively.

investigational_us_product.name: DrugSorb-ATR Antithrombotic Removal System
investigational_us_product.regulatory_status: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation (ticagrelor and DOACs). De Novo Request submitted Sept 2024; denied April 2025; appeal upheld denial Aug 2025 (no safety issues). New De Novo submission being prepared with additional real-world data; pre-submission FDA meeting held Jan 2026.
investigational_us_product.supporting_pivotal_trial: STAR-T (Safe and Timely Antithrombotic Removal - Ticagrelor): U.S./Canada double-blind RCT, 140 patients, completed enrollment July 2023. Did not meet primary effectiveness endpoint in overall population, but showed significant reduction in perioperative bleeding severity in pre-specified isolated CABG subgroup (>90% of trial). Final results published Jan 2026 in Journal of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery.

commercial_product.veterinary_product: VetResQ (formerly CytoSorb-XL) — emergency/critical care use in animals, commercialized primarily in U.S.

excluded_legacy_terminated.trial_status: On hold for business reasons; resources prioritized to STAR-T completion and FDA submissions. Future label-expansion discussions with FDA pending the ongoing DrugSorb-ATR review.
Paused; protocol amendment in progress due to slow enrollment. Company anticipates redesign completion in 2026.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated; CytoSorbents Europe is collaborator only. Trial COMPLETED.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device company (extracorporeal blood purification adsorbers). Lead pivotal IDE study (STAR-T) completed in 2023 and the company is now in FDA De Novo regulatory review for DrugSorb-ATR; no active enrolling company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 interventional studies of CytoSorbents' own devices at the snapshot date. STAR-D and PROCYSS are paused/on hold. Real-world STAR and COSMOS registries are observational, not interventional P1/P2/P3.
